title: fix(types): content-channel refusals name the parser tier's not-a-container warning (objectui#10928)
body:
Fixes #10928
Clause-②: no — message and `.describe()` text only; every accept or refuse verdict stays byte-identical (auxiliary face).

Implemented by the `os-dev` dispatched from the `domain:spec` seat, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_012UwY3ahMixEFkfTUxMVkYm` (`mode:subagent`). Base `5c94589f0`, head `5833df79f`.

## What changed

Only the false clause changes. It changes on every refusal of a node whose renderer reads NEITHER content channel (family D and the E3 residual, objectui#9256). "no error, no warning, no element" now reads:

> no render-time error or warning and no element; only the parser tier's `not-a-container` warning (objectui#9910) noticed it

This is the wording the objectui#10907 changesets settled on. Every site is in the past tense, so the clause is too. Every other byte of each string is unchanged; the proof is below.

- **zod mirror.** The refusal message and its `.describe()` text are one string. There are 131 literal sites in the 12 `*.zod.ts` files, plus the two builders that compose the rest:
  - the shared `neitherContentChannelGuidance` in `zod/tombstone.zod.ts` (13 consts, 26 arms);
  - `ai.zod.ts`'s local `neitherChannel` (6 arms).
  - The shared builder's three source lines were re-wrapped by hand. Its string value changes only in the clause.
- **TypeScript face.** 149 `body?: never` / `children?: never` docblocks in the 12 matching `packages/types/src/*.ts` files. They ship in the emitted `.d.ts`.
- **Only comment and string lines move.** Every changed line in the 12 TS files is a JSDoc continuation line. Every changed line in the zod files is a string-literal line. Other changed lines: 0 on each face (`git diff -U0`, filtered).
- **New pin:** `packages/types/src/__tests__/content-channel-parser-tier-clause-10928.test.ts`.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/10928-content-channel-parser-tier-clause.md`, `@object-ui/types: patch`.

## The parser tier, measured before the clause was written

**Instrument.** A one-shot probe, deleted and not committed. It builds the manifest from the live registry the way `container-declaration-ratchet.test.tsx` does: every KNOWN key, through `manifestFromConfigs`. `components`, `fields` and 18 of the 19 `plugin-*` packages (all but `plugin-designer`) are imported. It then runs `validateTree` once per leg.

**Population.** Every registry key, bare and namespaced, of the 81 node types whose refusal says "reads NEITHER content channel". That is 177 keys: 164 real registrations and 13 lazy stubs that have no inputs yet. None of the 177 declares a `children` input.

| leg added to the bare node | diagnostic it adds, identical on all 177 keys |
|---|---|
| `children: [node]` | `not-a-container` (warning) |
| `body: [node]` or `body: node` | `not-a-container` (warning), from `checkRetiredBodyDialect` over the same containment predicate |
| `body: 'hi'` (a scalar) | `unknown-prop` (warning) |
| neither key | nothing |

**Controls.** `div`, `ui:div`, `span` and `ui:span` declare `children`. On them, adding `children` adds nothing, and adding a `body` list adds `unknown-prop`.

**Reading.** The dispatch assumed that a node "with `body` (not `children`)" stays silent. It does not: a `body` child list draws the same `not-a-container`. So the settled clause is true for both members, which share one string. A scalar `body` draws `unknown-prop` instead; see the Acceptance notes.

## Census, base `5c94589f0` vs head `5833df79f`

The card's 126 and 139 come from a line-bound grep. The same clause also sits on 25 sites where a line break or a `'…' + '…'` join falls inside it: 15 zod (the shared builder among them) and 10 TS docblocks. So the count below joins those first.

| face | old clause, base → head | new clause, base → head | control `NEITHER content channel`, base / head |
|---|---|---|---|
| zod | 141 → 8 | 0 → 133 | 137 / 137 |
| TS docblocks | 149 → 0 | 0 → 149 | 162 / 162 |

- The absent-token control `qqzz_absent_token_9999` reads 0 in every cell.
- **The 8 old clauses left on the zod face are all in `HeaderBarSchema`:** `title`, `logo`, `nav`, `left`, `center`, `right`, `sticky` and `height`.
  - Those keys are not content channels. The parser tier answers each of them with `unknown-prop`, not `not-a-container`.
  - So the settled clause would be false there, and they are left untouched; see the Acceptance notes.
- The in-scope count is therefore 282 = 133 + 149, and each of those sites moved from the old clause to the new one.
- **Emitted `dist`**, after `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build` at head, joined the same way:
  - `.d.ts`: old 0, new 149.
  - JS: the 16 old clauses left are the 8 `HeaderBarSchema` strings, twice (`zod/navigation.zod.js` and `zod/index.zod.js`).

The command, exactly as run. The enumeration and the read both come from REF, and `__tests__` is excluded. JSDoc continuations and `'…' + '…'` joins are removed, and an escaped quote is unescaped.

```
for REF in 5c94589f0 5833df79f; do for FACE in zod ts; do
  if [ "$FACE" = zod ]; then X='--exclude=*/__tests__/*'; P=packages/types/src/zod; else X='--exclude=*/zod/*'; P=packages/types/src; fi
  printf '%s %-3s ' "$REF" "$FACE"
  git archive "$REF" "$P" | tar -xO --exclude='*/__tests__/*' "$X" | perl -0777 -ne 's/\n[ \t]*\*[ \t]?/ /g; s/\x27[ \t]*\n[ \t]*\+[ \t]*\x27//g; s/\\\x27/\x27/g; my $o = () = /no\s+error,\s+no\s+warning,\s+no\s+element/g; my $n = () = /no\s+render-time\s+error\s+or\s+warning\s+and\s+no\s+element;\s+only\s+the\s+parser\s+tier\x27s\s+`not-a-container`\s+warning\s+\(objectui#9910\)\s+noticed\s+it/g; my $c = () = /NEITHER\s+content\s+channel/g; my $z = () = /qqzz_absent_token_9999/g; print "old=$o new=$n control=$c absent=$z\n"'
done; done
```

## Verdicts unchanged, and every other byte of every message

**Instrument.** A one-shot probe, deleted and not committed. It records 777 keyed entries, taken once at base and once at head:

- every exported zod schema (241), each over 6 generic inputs: `{}`, a `children` list, a `body` list, a scalar `body`, a scalar `children`, and both keys;
- the `.describe()` text of every direct shape member of 196 object schemas;
- `safeValidateSchema` over 85 node types, each over 4 legs: none, `children`, a `body` list and a scalar `body`.

**Result.**

- Success flags, issue codes and issue paths are identical at base and head (116 successes at both).
- Messages and describe texts: take the head payload and substitute the old clause back for the new one. The result is byte-identical to the base payload. So each string changed in the clause and nowhere else.
- The old clause occurs 915 times in the base payload and 8 times in the head payload. Those 8 are the `HeaderBarSchema` refusals.
- On the built `dist`, `safeValidateSchema({ type: 'accordion', children: [...] })` answers `invalid_type` at `children`, and its message carries the new clause.

## Reverse verification (ablation), after the fix was committed

**Instrument.** objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, in WRAP mode. The anchor must hit the declared number of times, and the on-disk blob must move. The restore is proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. Each leg puts the old clause back in one message source and runs the new pin.

| mutation | blob mutated to | red / 10 | red tests |
|---|---|---|---|
| the shared builder, back to its base text | `8ff6af3b9` (the base blob) | 5 | both builder tests, `object-grid` × 2, the population |
| `accordion`'s two literal arms | `751bf2d6f` | 3 | `accordion` × 2, the population |
| `ai.zod.ts`'s `neitherChannel`, back to its base text | `1fd44f9e0` (the base blob) | 3 | `ai-form-assist` × 2, the population |

- Each leg restored to its HEAD blob (`da56e22f5`, `f7d88b6c5`, `a40e67ff6`) with an empty `git diff HEAD`.
- The types tests import `../zod/*` source directly, so no build sits between a mutation and the run.

## The pin, and why it holds the prose rather than the parser

`@object-ui/types` declares no workspace dependency, and its tests import none. So `@object-ui/sdui-parser` cannot be imported from here without declaring it (`check:phantom-deps`). The claim's file surface also put the pin under `packages/types/src/__tests__/`.

What the pin holds:

- **The shared builder.** The clause stands exactly where the retired one stood, and the retired one is gone.
- **One arm per message source,** each read through its refusal: a literal (`accordion`), the shared builder (`object-grid`) and the local builder (`ai-form-assist`). Each answers code `invalid_type` at the key's own path, and its message carries the clause.
- **The population.** Every exported member whose refusal is the family-D sentence carries the clause, so a later slice that copies an older literal goes red. Non-vacuity is asserted by name over the three sources, not by count.

The parser behaviour the clause describes stays pinned where the parser and the registry live, and the new file's header names those pins:

- `containment-declared-slot-9910.test.ts` and `body-dialect-6771.test.ts`, in `packages/sdui-parser`;
- `container-declaration-ratchet.test.tsx`, in `packages/components`. It holds declared-slot ⇔ rendered-list over the live registry.

Whether to add a live-registry behavioural pin in `packages/components` as well is left as an open question for the seat.

## Gates, head `5833df79f`

The gate list was derived by hand from objectui's root `package.json` and `.github/workflows/`, against this diff.

| gate | result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types build` (tsc, vite, dist completeness) | exit 0; "1 package(s) complete (134 emitted files verified)" |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (tsc, examples, tests) | exit 0; `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new pin |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types lint` | exit 0, 0 errors; the warnings are existing `no-explicit-any`, none on the new file |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/` | 267 files, 5917 tests, all passed |
| `check-changeset-presence` · `changeset:check` · `check-changeset-overwrite` | exit 0 each |
| `check:pending-changeset-literals` · `check:control-bytes` · `check:new-line-citations` (0 new) | exit 0 each |
| `check:handler-key-reads` · `type-check:coverage` · `lint:coverage` · `check:test-path-roots` · `check:unreferenced-sources` · `check:phantom-deps` · `check:published-tsconfig-exclude` · `check:esm-specifiers` · `check:spec-symbols` · `check:component-surface-parity` · `check:doc-types` | exit 0 each |
| `check:changeset-claims` | report-only, exit 0. Each pending changeset it names for a touched file was read; none quotes the replaced clause. |
| governed guard `--test` over the diff's paths | NOT GOVERNED (lit control `AGENTS.md`: exit 3) |

- **NOT MEASURED: `check:readme-exports`.** It judges README self-imports against every package's `dist/*.d.ts`. This tree built only `@object-ui/types`, so the gate printed "could not be judged … run `pnpm build` first" and exited 1. That is a prerequisite, not a finding. This diff touches no README and no export.
- **NOT MEASURED, left to CI:** `pnpm test` beyond `packages/types`, the `dom` / `dom-heavy` projects, E2E and `test:dist`.

## Serial constraints

- **Open PRs**, mapped at hand-back: 13 open, files API, every page. Only objectui#10930 touches a file here: `zod/complex.zod.ts`, in the `GlobalFilterSchema` JSDoc.
  - `git merge-tree` of this head against its head `1daf7edf7` is clean.
  - Its head adds no old-clause site.
- **`main`** moved two commits since the base, to `06a96e948`. Neither touches `packages/types` or `packages/sdui-parser`, and `git merge-tree` against it is clean.

## Acceptance notes: out of scope, not changed here

- **`HeaderBarSchema`'s nine non-channel refusals** (`zod/navigation.zod.ts`).
  - Eight carry the same "no error, no warning, no element": `title`, `logo`, `nav`, `left`, `center`, `right`, `sticky` and `height`. `variant` says "no error, no warning, no class".
  - The parser tier answers each of the nine keys with `unknown-prop` (measured, same probe).
  - `safeValidateSchema({ type: 'header-bar', title: 'T' })` hands back the "no warning" message (measured on the built `dist`).
  - Same defect class as this card, but the fix needs a different clause, one naming `unknown-prop`. So it is reported to the seat, not swept here.
- **The nine objectui#8284 `body?: never` docblocks** on `box`, `span`, `container`, `flex`, `stack`, `grid`, `scroll-area`, `form` and `toggle` (in `layout.ts` and `form.ts`).
  - They say a `body` "rendered an EMPTY element with no error and no warning".
  - Each of those registrations declares `children`, and a `body` list on it draws `unknown-prop` (measured on every bare and `ui:` key).
  - TypeScript face only. Same class; reported, not changed.
- **A scalar `body`** on a reads-neither node draws `unknown-prop`, not `not-a-container`. The clause speaks of an authored content value, which in both channels is a child list or a node. The scalar case is not written into it.
